about: THE content plan for TM_Diamond (owner rule 2026-11-06: no random topics). Everything follows one theme at a time. Each block = one long YouTube video (the pillar) + short 'One-Minute Tech Fixes' episodes taken from it, in order. Shorts, Facebook videos and TikTok all take the NEXT unused episode of the CURRENT block (the first block that still has unused episodes); set used_by to your folder (e.g. 'shorts/03'). The long-video task makes the long video of the first block whose long video is not made. Every episode is shown on real Windows screens in the Team Diamond template (fb/07). Fact-check each one; if an episode can't be shown for real on the Windows runner, mark used_by 'skipped: <reason>' and take the next. When the last block runs low, add the next block from HOUSE_STYLE's long-video order in the same shape.
